about: The controlled fault with only the one look per claim repaired: the recall still trusts the stamp, so a claim whose scope moved still reads fresh and the verifier must still fail it.

mutations.find: const scopes = Object.assign({}, ...claims.map((c) => measure([{ scope: watched(c) }], ctx.know.model().model, ctx.source)));
mutations.replace: const scopes = measure(claims.map((c) => ({ scope: watched(c) })), ctx.know.model().model, ctx.source);
